translations.name: The Quran: A Monotheist Translation
translations.note: Translated on Quran-alone principles; renders terms from internal usage rather than classical tafsir. Confirm redistribution terms with the publisher.

translations.name: Quran in English
translations.note: Plain modern English, very low interpolation. Widely described as freely distributable; confirm before shipping.

translations.name: The Noble Quran: A New Rendering
translations.note: 0.001 interpolated spans per verse, effectively none. Modern readable English. Confirm redistribution terms with the publisher.

translations.name: The Koran Interpreted
translations.note: Measured at 0.003 interpolated spans per verse, among the lowest of any translation. Arberry deliberately declined to add explanatory material and aimed to carry the rhetorical shape of the Arabic. Author died 1969; confirm copyright status before shipping.

translations.name: The Sublime Quran
translations.note: Renders each Arabic root by a consistent English word throughout, which makes translator consistency auditable against the root data. Marks her own additions with carets. Copyrighted; permission required.

translations.name: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
translations.note: Almost literal. Author died 1936; text is public domain.

translations.name: Saheeh International
translations.translator: Emily Assami, Mary Kennedy, Amatullah Bantley
translations.note: Commonly described as free for NON-COMMERCIAL Islamic educational use. Donations, advertising, or any paid tier would fall outside that. Confirm terms with Abul Qasim Publishing House before monetising the site.

translations.name: The Holy Qur'an
translations.note: Original edition, not the 1946 Al-Rawaf printing or the King Fahd revision. Footnotes excluded.

translations.name: The Qur'an As It Explains Itself
translations.note: Expansive, self-referential method. High word count per verse; much explanatory material is unbracketed and will NOT be caught by segmentation.

translations.name: The Clear Quran — divine name as “Allah”
translations.note: Copyright Book of Signs Foundation. Actively enforced; the quran.com licence does not extend to third parties. Written permission required. Renders the divine name as Allah.

translations.name: The Clear Quran — divine name as “God”
translations.note: Copyright Book of Signs Foundation. Actively enforced; the quran.com licence does not extend to third parties. Written permission required. Renders the divine name as God.

translations.name: The Holy Qur'an
translations.note: Copyright status contested; widely alleged to derive from earlier translations. Included for comparison only.

translations.name: The Koran
translations.note: Historical interest. Archaic and polemical framing.

translations.name: The Koran
translations.note: Historical interest. Reorders surahs in print; this dataset uses standard order.
